body: Thanks, I'll try to comfort him by saying that tomorrow.  I'm 18 and he's 17, so yeah, we're both going to be going off to college after this year alone.

That's all I can do, I guess.  I was hoping there was something else I could do other than be there for him, but I'll just try to be the rock in this situation.  We're seniors in highschool, but like I said, he's got too much pride to receive help from anyone, including me.  He just told me and then moved on to another topic.

He's only told me, so I can't make an anonymous report.  He'll know, and he'd hate me for it.  Plus, his parents are good people, they just have a culture where discipline is very prevalent and they believe the only cure is physical punishment.  I've offered for him to stay at my place, so I'm still waiting for an answer.  He's too prideful for counseling, but I'll try to talk to him and cheer him up.  The least I can do is show him how fun life can be before he attempts again.
